archetypes.name: dyn-git-trailers
archetypes.rationale: Git trailer parsing and commit ancestry jointly control the new reship authorization boundary.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the changed salvage validator against Git's actual trailer-block semantics, including duplicate, misplaced, case-variant, and unreadable trailer data. Verify that normal dispatch and crash recovery apply identical ancestry and lane-step provenance checks before reship. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
